from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u090/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            nines = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                nines += grid[y][x] == 9
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 0 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            components.append((nines, cells))
    least = min(n for n, _ in components)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for n, cells in components:
        if n == least:
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = 0
    return out
'''
